description: This file implements the HdmiCecSink plugin for managing HDMI CEC functionalities, including device discovery, active source management, and CEC message processing. It includes class definitions, methods for enabling/disabling CEC, handling HDMI hotplug events, and communication with external CEC devices.

classes.name: HdmiCecSink
classes.description: Main plugin class managing HDMI CEC functionalities, device discovery, and message handling.

classes.name: HdmiCecSinkFrameListener
classes.description: Listener class for CEC frames, responsible for receiving and logging CEC frames.

classes.name: HdmiCecSinkProcessor
classes.description: Processor class for handling various CEC messages and commands.

methods.name: HdmiCecSink::setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the CEC functionality and persists the setting.

methods.name: HdmiCecSink::getActiveSource
methods.description: Retrieves the current active source device information.

methods.name: HdmiCecSink::getDeviceList
methods.description: Returns the list of connected devices.

methods.name: HdmiCecSink::setOSDName
methods.description: Sets the On-Screen Display name for the device.

methods.name: HdmiCecSink::printDeviceList
methods.description: Prints the list of connected devices to logs.

methods.name: HdmiCecSink::setActivePath
methods.description: Sets the active HDMI stream path.

methods.name: HdmiCecSink::setVendorId
methods.description: Sets the vendor ID for the device.
